newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London fall as yen strengthens.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London fall as yen strengthens.

text.p: Japanese shares in London were mostly lower on Friday, with the major exporting stocks suffering the worst declines as the yen firmed against the dollar, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 index in London fell 3.13 points to 1,584.09 by the close, after profit taking in Tokyo dragged the Nikkei 225 down 259.03 points to finish at 19.802.78.
Among blue chip international stocks, Sony was down 25 yen to 9,495 yen in London from its Tokyo close.
The dollar has slid against the yen in the last three days to around 121.60 yen from a high of 126.82 yen, raising concerns that Japanese exporters earnings could be hit by the yen strength.
"With the yen's rise and the lack of a quote on the Nikkei future in Chicago, the omens for a good day on Monday look non-existent," said one dealer.
Dealers said volumes were light, with the bulk of the business related to trade in derivatives.
